blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V102 renders: six stronger boundary-preserving fairing passes did not remove the repeated transverse corrugation and waist-to-hem pinching visible on both side views and the rear. The overskirt surface remains visibly below acceptance.

Restricting trim to canonical hem-role chains and reducing bevel bulk did not eliminate lavender spikes and uneven angular joins at shared hem corners across front, rear, and side views. Endpoint transitions remain visually unresolved.

Crouch, sit, and prone renders show the overskirt lifting/folding behind the raised thighs with angular overlaps; the shorts become exposed in crouch/sit. The prototype does not verify avatar fit, calibrated cloth/material response, final skinning/weights, shape-key coverage, Unity/VRChat runtime, or package eligibility.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
